description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying {4}{U}, creating a nonlegendary copy of Carth the Lion and exiling Quantum Misalignment.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, you may cast Quantum Misalignment from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting anything.
In your next draw step, draw Beacon of Tomorrows.
Repeat from step 2, skipping step 4.
